# Data Source: auth0_user_organizations

Data source to retrieve all organization memberships for a specific Auth0 user (EA only).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "auth0_user_organizations" "my_user_organizations" {
  user_id = "auth0|XXXXX"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user to retrieve the organization memberships for.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `organizations` (List of Object) The list of organizations the user is a member of. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations))

<a id="nestedatt--organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations`

Read-Only:

- `branding` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--organizations--branding))
- `display_name` (String)
- `is_app_entitlement_active` (Boolean)
- `metadata` (Map of String)
- `name` (String)
- `organization_id` (String)
- `third_party_client_access` (String)
- `token_quota` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--organizations--token_quota))
